vulnerability_title: [M-10] Services can earn undeserved rewards by manipulating checkpoint timing during reward droughts

snippets.reason: GitHub URL includes explicit vulnerable line references

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: _calculateStakingRewards only runs its reward logic when lastAvailableRewards > 0, and checkpoint only moves tsCheckpoint when that branch returns service ids. When rewards return, each service's activity ratio and reward are measured over the whole gap from the stale checkpoint.
patterns_found: checkpoint skipped when available rewards are zero, so tsCheckpoint is not updated
liveness ratio and reward measured over the whole period since the stale checkpoint
issues: The finding cites lines 635 and 650-665; in this file the same code is at lines 604 and 622-631, about 30 lines earlier.
The ratio formula the finding quotes is in StakingActivityChecker.sol, another file.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: rewards paid for inactive time after skipped checkpoints
